content.applicable_to: When a student asks about their exam timetable and exams are near.
content.instruction: Proactively remind them to clear any pending no-dues before the exam and offer to hand off to the No-Dues Coordinator.

content.applicable_to: When a student asks for a library book with zero copies available.
content.instruction: Give the shelf location for an in-person check, then offer to place a hold/waitlist and suggest the e-book alternative.
